reason: A dsh web plugin primarily focused on mobile and responsive interface adaptation, with mobile navigation, settings, directory browsing, and local file upload to the session workspace.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh web 提供移动端界面适配，包括侧边栏、设置页、目录浏览和本地文件上传功能。
summaries.en: Adapts the dsh web interface for mobile devices with responsive navigation, settings, directory browsing, and local file uploads.

capabilities: Adapts the dsh web interface for mobile layouts
Adds mobile sidebar, settings, directory browsing, and toolbar interactions
Uploads local files through an RPC channel
Writes uploaded files to the current session workspace under ./上传/
Integrates with the dsh directory-picker browse components
